column1: # The noise budget of each measure: the largest spread its rounds may show before the run is marked
# noisy and kept out of the published tables. Spread is the interquartile range over the median
# (IQR / p50) of a measure's numeric samples, so it needs three or more rounds. First match wins;
# the left column is a glob over the measure's name, lowercased; `-` means the measure is a count
# or a verdict that has no spread to budget. scripts/bench/summarize.py; docs/research/bench-protocol.md.
# BENCH_NOISE_BUDGET=0.2 replaces every budget, for a run where the host can't be made quieter.
